title: Rise Up, Shepherd, and Follow
print: The engraving SDAHImages 138.png (github.com/adventHymnals/SDAHImages, docs/seventh-day-adventist-hymnal/SDAHimages/138.png), read line by line on 2026-10-18. Five systems: bars 1-4, 5-9, 10-14, 15-19 and 20-25, as the engraving numbers them. The stanzas are lyric rows 1. and 2. under bars 1-8; the refrain, marked Refrain, starts at the double bar in bar 9 and ends at the final barline. hymnal.db had "lamb" where the refrain prints "lambs" (the hymnal's earlier chord chart has "lambs" too). Each line is as the engraving prints it, its syllables joined, its punctuation kept.

stanzas.text: There's a star in the east on Christmas morn.
It will lead to the place where the Savior's born,
If you take good heed to the angel's words,
You'll forget your flocks, you'll forget your herds,

lines.text: Leave your sheep and leave your lambs,
Leave your ewes and leave your rams,
